The name is a reminder that no matter how daunting or insurmountable the challenges may seem, with the help of Allah, one can overcome them. It is a name that inspires one to be steadfast in their faith, to be a source of strength and courage to others, and to be a courageous and valiant servant of Allah. It is a name that reflects the fundamental Islamic belief in the power of faith and determination to overcome adversity, and to live a life of purpose and meaning.
